title: Hessdalen expedition in the early 1980s
summary: Clas Svahn tells of Hessdalen expedition in the early 1980s, about early 1980s to present at Hessdalen, Norway, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote:
First, uh, in the 1980s, early
1980s, we and you from Norway had this
huge expedition there and we could take
pictures of them. We can also see them
on radar once.

plain: Clas Svahn, a Swedish UFO researcher, talks about Hessdalen, a valley in Norway where people report strange things in the sky. He says that in the early 1980s, Swedish and Norwegian researchers ran a big expedition there and managed to photograph the things they were looking for, and once even caught them on radar. If true, it would mean the sightings there could be recorded by cameras and instruments, not just by people's eyes.
